key_terms: A time to live attached to written data, after which the value no longer appears in reads even though its storage is not reclaimed immediately.
A deletion marker that prevents older replicas or SSTables from reintroducing a deleted value during reconciliation.
The table setting for how long tombstones must be kept before compaction may purge them, which must exceed the interval between repairs.
An anti-entropy operation that compares and reconciles replicas, ensuring that deletions and updates reach every replica.
Merging SSTables, resolving cell versions and eventually purging expired tombstones and data.

worked_examples.title: Watch a TTL count down
worked_examples.interpretation: Right after the insert, remaining is at most 5 and decreases on each read; once it reaches zero the row stops appearing. The client polls under a fifteen-second deadline instead of sleeping exactly five seconds, because coordinator clocks and request latency make an exact boundary unreliable. After expiry the cell becomes a tombstone in an SSTable, so disk usage does not drop until compaction runs after gc_grace_seconds has passed.

worked_examples.title: Delete versus snapshot retention
worked_examples.code:
cd work/cassandra
bash run.sh check
bash run.sh check-backup
worked_examples.interpretation: The check route inserts and deletes a probe key and requires that a read returns nothing, which proves logical absence for current readers. The backup check works with snapshots, which are hard links to SSTable files taken at a point in time; a snapshot taken before the delete still holds the old value on disk. That combination is the usual answer to a deletion request audit: the live table is correct, but erasure also needs snapshot expiry and compaction. Shortening gc_grace_seconds to speed things up risks resurrected data if a replica missed the delete and repair has not run.

evidence: Actual native ARM64 Cassandra 5.0.9 CQL and retained-state observations; RF3 outage and table-level SSTable restore have independent acceptance receipts. Commands run only in the copied owned Docker project.
